title: Reply to Taleb on whether the future is cool
why: Opinion piece on cultural change and tech progress; sweeping claims with little concrete explanation.

title: What restricted stock means and its tax trap

title: Bitcoin exists only as a blockchain record, unlike gold

title: Complaint that JSON is verbose versus S-expressions

title: Argument that apps are the wrong unit for phones

title: Robotics expert rebuts automation hype with specifics
why: Self-checkouts often extend store hours rather than only cutting staff, and self-driving cars remain far from broad deployment.

title: Hypocrisy argument over sports sanctions
why: Political argument about sanctions and US history; opinion without technical substance.

title: Insider view on why Google's interviews are hard
why: Interns' feedback counts toward half their full-time interviews, a big advantage; even strong engineers might struggle cold.
